why: E20 part 1: scripts/ci/check_manager_scope.py exists to fail a manager commit that does a worker's item, and the 2026-09-21 operating reset archived docs/claude/work/MANAGER-LEASE.json -- the ONLY surface it derived manager identity from. Measured 2026-09-22: the roster froze at 7 sessions whose last lease run ended 2026-09-19, 2026-09-22's manager is not among them, and all 38 of its commits graded `not_manager` and were skipped while `manager-scope-guard` stayed in the green list. This adds a second derived identity source (a commit that assigns a checklist row's lane to ANOTHER session), makes the guard FAIL AT EXIT 2 when no source can still grow, plants the 2026-09-21 regression as a self-test case, and reports R6/R7/R8 as DEAD rather than silently grading nothing. Tier-1 by the canonical doc's own list and verifiable against the diff: the ONLY files changed are scripts/ci/check_manager_scope.py (CI/validation tooling), docs/claude/work/PIPELINE.jsonl (one filed row), docs/claude/work/MANAGER-CHECKLIST.json (this lane's own row state), and the landing/arming/merge-slot files the self-land route itself requires. NO src/, no config/, no deploy/, no .github/workflows/, no order path, no strategy params, no risk caps, no runtime behaviour. The guard is CI-only and runs on PRs; the self-test goes 33 -> 40 cases and every planted defect fails. MANAGER_SURFACE is deliberately NOT widened to make the manager's own commits pass -- 18 of the 38 still fail R2 after this change, measured and recorded in the module docstring.
